positive: Diagnose a reproducible regression whose root cause is unknown.
Investigate a test failure after several unsuccessful fixes.
near_negative: Implement an already specified change with a known mechanism.
Brainstorm an uncommitted product feature without a failure to diagnose.

behavior_assertions.assert: Each attempted fix is tied to a falsifiable hypothesis and fresh evidence.

behavior_assertions: A hypothesis repeated unsuccessfully three times triggers an architectural reassessment.
